opening.argument: The video presents Forsage as an income opportunity by displaying purported earnings and directing viewers toward the speaker’s team. Its title identifies the subject as “Forsage Platform Income Proof,” while the speaker claims someone can earn “2 lakh within two days.” The promotion then links that rapid-income claim to recruitment: “Come, join my team, I will make it possible.” A phone screen shows a Forsage-related interface with a highlighted balance or income figure, and the speaker points to purported current figures, saying viewers “can check $390, 64 or 75 thousand of today's income.” Together, these statements use displayed income claims to encourage joining the team for rapid earnings.
